crossRefs.note: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear…
“You also came down on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good…
and made known to them your holy Sabbath, and commanded them commandments, statutes, and a law, by Moses your servant,
Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!
Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
I gave them my statutes, and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.
Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?
Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you…
They rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified to…
They abandoned all the commandments of Yahweh their God, and made molten images for themselves, even two calves, and…
“Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against you, cast your law behind their back, killed your prophets…
since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?
For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear Yahweh’s law;
Yahweh says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you…
I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not listen!’

translations.web: I wrote for him the many things of my law; but they were regarded as a strange thing.
translations.bsb: Though I wrote for them the great things of My law, they regarded them as something strange.
translations.kjv: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.
translations.asv: I wrote for him the ten thousand things of my law; but they are counted as a strange thing.
